Market today: Tech is sending mixed signals. Apple hit $5 trillion, a huge positive, but concerns are rising about AI spending hitting profits for other giants like Alphabet and Tesla, which could spread. This directly impacts your concentrated tech/chip book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-57.15%) and SPAL (-54.75%) are leveraged ETFs with massive losses and stops far above current prices; these need immediate attention. QQQ (-5.41%), QQQI (-7.65%), and SMH (-16.92%) are also close to their stops. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on your leveraged positions and their stops. Also, monitor broader tech sentiment for any spillover from AI spending concerns.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk on your leveraged positions and respecting stops, especially with tech's mixed signals.
plays: SOXL and SPAL: Your stops at 200 and 21.38 respectively are way off current prices (109.05, 11.38). Re-evaluate these leveraged positions and adjust stops immediately to reflect current risk.
QQQ, QQQI, SMH: These are all near their stops. Respect your defined stops at 670, 52, and 540 to prevent further drawdowns.
AAPL: Apple's $5T milestone is big news. Scanner shows a long setup: entry 339.39-339.05, stop 338.42. Consider if you want to add or initiate a new position.
